description: Swaps the source pixels of a pixel layer with another image file, keeping its transform, mask and properties. Use it to round-trip a layer through an external editor or a generated image.

keepDisplaySize.description: true keeps the on-canvas size; false shows the new image 1:1

layer.description: Layer UUID or its exact name

path.description: Path to the .comp project package (a directory ending in .comp)

name: replace_layer_image
title: Replace layer pixels
